name: Recovery shake powder
identity: Carbohydrate and protein recovery drink powder, about 60 to 73 g carbohydrate and 18 to 30 g protein per 100 g; sold flavoured.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the three labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it (flavoured by nature). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from Open Food Facts through Akari's proxy, as the beef protein isolate was.

labels.ingredients: Weiproteïne-isolaat (bevat melk); maltodextrine; sucrose; fructose; magere cacaopoeder (Theobroma cacao L.); trinatriumcitraat; natuurlijke smaakstoffen; emulgator: sojalecithine melk, soja, gluten, ei, vis, schaaldieren en sulfiet verwerkt worden. kaliumchloride; trimagnesiumcitraat; antiklontermid
